governanceConstraints.note: An approved future adjudication does not itself satisfy the current normative-promotion policy. A later governance stage must define any adjudication-based eligibility route without rewriting Phase 1 historical classifications.

dispositionVocabulary.description: Accept a forward translation rule for project specification.
Resolve through explicit Unicode/text normalization behavior.
Resolve through a translation mode boundary or mode marker rule.
Resolve as project layout/whitespace policy rather than a character rule.
Explicitly ignore a format/control scalar in the selected profile.
Record that the selected profile intentionally does not support the item.
Record that the item is outside the selected profile/specification scope.
Keep the item unresolved pending stronger evidence.

batches.title: Unresolved decisions
batches.reason: Phase 1 could not establish a project decision. Evidence must be examined before any disposition can be proposed.

batches.title: Implementation conflicts
batches.reason: Observed stable and draft implementations differ and require explicit adjudication.

batches.title: Implementation alignment
batches.reason: Observed stable and draft implementations align, but the Phase 1 decision remains REVIEW-REQUIRED and therefore still requires human adjudication.
